description: This PHP source file defines the AuthorizationController class within the OrangeHRM OAuth 2.0 plugin. The class handles OAuth2 authorization requests, validating authorization requests, being compliant with PSR-7 HTTP message interfaces, and managing exception handling for OAuth server errors and general errors. It leverages several traits for logging, user role management, OAuth server handling, and PSR-7 request/response creation.

classes.name: AuthorizationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling OAuth 2.0 authorization requests within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin. It manages request validation, user authorization approval, and response generation, including error handling.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the OAuth2 authorization request by validating it, setting the user, processing user approval, and generating the appropriate HTTP response or handling exceptions accordingly.
